name: New York

flag.description: A dark blue field with the state coat of arms: a shield showing the sun rising over the Hudson River with sailing ships, supported by Liberty and Justice, topped by an eagle on a globe, with the ribbons "E Pluribus Unum" and "Excelsior" below.
flag.symbolism: Liberty has a discarded crown at her feet to mark independence from Britain, Justice is blindfolded with scales, and "Excelsior" means "ever upward".

hook: New York's shield is flanked by two women, blindfolded Justice and Liberty, on blue; New Jersey's women stand on buff, and Pennsylvania uses horses.
trivia: In 2020 the state added "E Pluribus Unum" on a scroll beneath the shield of the coat of arms, and so to the flag.
The flag's design dates from 1901, but the arms themselves go back to 1778.
